ad_info.structure_source: library format F36 (Línea de tiempo con sello de segmento, winning structure mv-04)
ad_info.reference_style: Flat illustration timeline supplement ad with segment seal, product hero and full-width offer bar
ad_info.angle_used: Rutina / momento de uso: the 3-month plan step by step, for moms

global_identity.color_palette: Hot fuchsia #E6177F (seal, timeline dots, offer bar), deep magenta #B0105E, dark plum #2B1226 (headline, pill and step labels), bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, pale blush pink #FBE3EE, white #FFFFFF. Secondary for this variation: warm cream #FFF6EE background and soft leaf green #7FA66A only inside the ingredient illustrations.
global_identity.visual_style: Clean flat illustration layout with soft watercolor-like ingredient drawings, and the real bottle photoreal and sharp.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Calm, organized and reassuring; warm cream light, motherly and hopeful.
global_identity.graphic_language: Bold headline block, rounded pill, square seal with a double border, vertical timeline with round dots joined by a thin line, small ingredient illustrations, full-width offer bar.
global_identity.text_typography: Headline in very heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat Black look), uppercase; step labels in heavy uppercase; step texts in rounded sans-serif (Poppins Medium/SemiBold look), sentence case.

creative_objective: Show moms who want to recover their figure that the plan is simple and doable: a 3-month timeline with what many women report at each stage, the bottle as hero and the treatment offer at the bottom, keeping the exact F36 structure.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) the headline, 2) the segment seal, 3) the timeline, 4) the bottle, 5) the offer bar.
art_direction.composition_style: Top 22%: headline across the width, pill under it on the left, square seal on the right. Middle 66%: left half vertical timeline with 5 steps and an ingredient drawing left of each dot; right half the large bottle. Bottom 12%: full-width offer bar.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Generous even spacing between timeline steps; strong left alignment; bottle centered in the right half.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Flat, even light on the layout; soft natural shadow under the bottle only.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Warm cream background. Top: 2-line dark plum uppercase headline; under it on the left a dark plum rounded pill with white text; on the right a square fuchsia seal with a thin double border and white text. Middle-left: a vertical timeline (thin dark plum line with 5 fuchsia dots), each step with a heavy dark plum label and a 2-line text, and a small flat ingredient illustration to the left of each dot. Middle-right: the large real bottle standing. Bottom: a full-width fuchsia bar with the offer in white uppercase and a small registration line inside it.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 clean flat-design supplement ad on a warm cream #FFF6EE background. TOP 22%: a 2-line headline in very heavy dark plum #2B1226 uppercase geometric sans-serif across the width; under it, on the left, a dark plum rounded pill with white uppercase text; on the right, a square hot-fuchsia #E6177F seal with rounded corners and a thin double white border, with white uppercase text in 3 or 4 lines. MIDDLE 66%: the left half holds a vertical timeline, a thin dark plum line joining 5 hot-fuchsia dots spaced evenly; next to each dot a heavy dark plum uppercase step label and a short 2-line text in dark gray-plum sentence case. To the left of each dot, a small flat watercolor-like illustration, in this order from top to bottom: a cluster of reddish-brown scaly aguaje palm fruits, golden fenugreek seeds with small trefoil leaves, a dark black maca root, a fresh green leaf sprig, and two glossy fuchsia capsules. The right half holds the large real product bottle, upright, razor sharp, with a soft natural shadow: a matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern, and a solid hot-pink band wrapping the bottom fifth of the bottle; black label with the small pink VITALABH emblem, the huge bold white word 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a thin hot-pink banner 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS', the small line 'A base de Aguaje, Fenogreco y Maca Negra', a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a swoosh, three pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO', '200mg MACA NEGRA' joined by plus signs, and '60 CÁPSULAS | (0.5 g c/u Cont. Neto 30g)'. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the bottle: do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. BOTTOM 12%: a hot-fuchsia bar from edge to edge with the offer in bold white uppercase and, under it inside the same bar, a smaller white registration line. No people, no bodies. Do not add a logo, price, discount, button, stars or any extra text.
